## Flowscope: error alerts
1. Connect Gmail in **Email me** (or swap in Slack / Discord).
2. Save this workflow.
3. In every other workflow: **Settings > Error Workflow** > pick **Flowscope: error alerts**.

Now when anything breaks, you hear about it in minutes, not from an angry user.
